messages:
Alex: Quick status check on the EU GPU buildout — where are we on procurement ETAs and canary nodes?
Maria: Procurement confirmed 8x racks arrive Wed (carrier updated ETA). Still waiting on final manifest from vendor.
Jia: Rack manifest incoming this afternoon. Two SKUs: A100-80GB and H100-80GB, mix depends on final pickup.
Sam: Heads up — QA wants at least 2 H100 nodes in canary before we open reservations. Can infra guarantee those?
Taylor: We can prioritize H100s for the canary pool but need the inventory mapping first. If vendor can mark which chassis contain H100s we can flag them.
Maria: Pushed vendor for chassis-level manifest. ETA 16:30 UTC.
Alex: If manifest slips past EOD, what's fallback? Can we run canary on A100-80GB with quantized model to approximate perf?
Jia: We could. Perf won't match H100 latencies but we can exercise orchestration, KV cache, and autoscale behavior. Mark it as "canary-lite".
Sam: OK but QA needs metric set to reflect expected H100 token latency — we'll annotate tests as "proxy canary" if we go that route.
Taylor: Ops ask: do we have firmware window for the racks? If not, we may not be able to flash latest NICs before customer handoff.
Maria: There's a maintenance window booked Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC but vendor wants an hour buffer for power cycles.
Alex: Good. Ownership: Maria owns vendor follow-ups & manifest, Jia owns canary config + reservation mapping, Taylor owns firmware plan. Sam/QA will sign off on canary results. I'll own go/no-go decision.
Sam: Quick check on capacity reservations — can we allocate the provisional canary slice without consuming committed customer reservations? Need isolation for test traffic.
Jia: Yes, we can carve a temporary slice in staging pool (reservation id `temp-canary-2024-03`). I'll create it and share ACLs.
Taylor: Also tagging eng-sre for monitoring hook — need token-level tracing for the canary routes. @eng-sre can you confirm tracer config?
OpsBot: @eng-sre: new reservation `temp-canary-2024-03` created by Jia. ACLs: eng, qa, infra.
Sam: Perfect, post the tracer dashboard link when ready.
Maria: Vendor manifest just arrived (partial): chassis 3/8 flagged H100, rest mixed. Sending full CSV to infra channel.
Jia: Received CSV, doing SKU->rack mapping now. Will prioritize H100 chassis into canary pool and create reservation by 18:30 UTC.
Alex: Timeline recap: vendor manifest by 16:30 (arrived), infra mapping + temp reservation by 18:30, firmware window Thu 02:00-04:00 (Taylor), QA will run proxy canary if H100 count < 2, final go/no-go after canary results (Alex).
Taylor: One blocker: a PDU kit for rack-05 is missing per packing list. Maria, can you confirm vendor is sending kit or we swap to spare?
Maria: Escalated to vendor logistics. If not delivered, we'll swap rack-05 with spare rack-09 (has matching cabinet). Not blocking canary unless H100s are in rack-05.
Jia: Noted — will avoid assigning H100 nodes from rack-05 until confirmed.
Sam: Small ask: can we add a test prompt set that stresses long-context KV cache (16k tokens) so we validate memory and latency?
Taylor: Good call. Jia, can you add that to the canary runbook?
Jia: Yep — adding test suite "kv-stress-16k" and will include token/latency thresholds.
Alex: Thanks all. I'll ping again at 18:45 with go/no-go plan. If anything slips, post updates here. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks — will update if vendor changes.
Taylor: I'll prepare firmware runbook and tag oncall.
Sam: QA will be standing by for the reservation and tracer dashboard.
OpsBot: Reservation `temp-canary-2024-03` updated: ACLs confirmed, status: pending node assignment.
